question: 哪些门店的退款订单占比更高？
description: 先按订单汇总退款，再关联门店与商品。退款订单占比 = 有退款记录的有效订单数 / 有效订单总数；不是退款金额占比。金额为元。
sql:
WITH refund_by_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refunded
  FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT s.store_name AS 门店, COUNT(*) AS 有效订单数,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.refunded > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 退款订单数,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.refunded > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 退款订单占比_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(o.amount),2) AS 商品总额,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.refunded,0)),2) AS 退款总额
FROM clean_orders o
JOIN stores s USING(store_id)
JOIN products p USING(product_id)
LEFT JOIN refund_by_order r USING(order_id)
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY 退款订单占比_pct DESC, s.store_id;

question: 各门店的销售额环比如何变化？
description: 按有效订单计算商品总额，未减退款。用 LAG 比较相邻月份；样例只覆盖 2026-10 与 2026-11，不代表完整经营周期。

question: 不同商品类别贡献了多少销售额？
description: 关联有效订单、商品和门店，按类别聚合。占比以全部有效订单商品总额为分母。
sql:
SELECT p.category AS 商品类别, COUNT(*) AS 订单数,
 SUM(o.quantity) AS 销量, SUM(o.amount) AS 商品总额,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(o.amount)/SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER(),2) AS 销售额占比_pct
FROM clean_orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) JOIN stores s USING(store_id)
GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 商品总额 DESC;

question: 有哪些金额偏离均值的订单？
description: 探索性规则：金额偏离均值超过 2 倍总体标准差。用偏差平方比较，避免依赖 SQRT 扩展。小样本信号不能认定业务异常。
sql:
WITH stats AS (
 SELECT AVG(amount) AS mean, AVG(amount*amount)-AVG(amount)*AVG(amount) AS variance FROM clean_orders
)
SELECT o.order_id AS 订单号, o.amount AS 金额, ROUND(s.mean,2) AS 样本均值,
 ROUND(s.variance,2) AS 总体方差
FROM clean_orders o CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE s.variance>0 AND (o.amount-s.mean)*(o.amount-s.mean)>4*s.variance
ORDER BY o.order_id;
